name: Ten Years of Rain
storyline: You hear the endless patter of the rain against your tent, a sound that has accompanied the bulk of your youth. You’ve lived on the mountaintop for ten years, your hawk and blade your only companions. As you move through the martial steps of the sword dance, you notice…silence. The cursed rain has stopped, and you rush outside to feel the sun on your face for the first time in years. Looking in the distance, you see the water begin to recede, as a new world opens up before you…
summary: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...
